name: Monte Carlo Path Contribution Estimation
definition: A Monte Carlo estimator to calculate the radiance contribution of a stationary path found by the BFGS solver, based on the path formulation of the Radiative Radiative Transfer Equation (RRTE).
summary: Monte Carlo Path Contribution Estimation calculates radiance for specific stationary paths found by BFGS, differing from standard path tracing by avoiding stochastic camera sampling.
